title: Integration gaps between individually valid guards
failurePattern: Two or more guards can pass their isolated tests while an integration path skips a shared precondition.
A recovery or startup path can interpret state before applying compatibility or authority checks.
A state that is safe to pause or yield is not necessarily safe to clean up or delete.
designResponse: Move shared preconditions to a common integration entry before state interpretation.
Apply Human Gate / authority eligibility consistently across normal, recovery, and startup paths.
Separate semantic yield eligibility from destructive cleanup eligibility.
Add permanent cross-component regression fixtures rather than relying only on component-local tests.
limitations: The public model does not disclose the private production guard inventory or current recovery / startup routing.

Passing the public fixture proves the synthetic guard-composition contract only, not byte-for-byte identity with private production code, independent authentication of field operation, or disclosure of live authority internals.
